text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: euc2-ingress: sudden 5xx spike (aggregate 502/504) across ALB fronting customer endpoints. Paging oncall. (alert_id: alb-ingress-5xx-euc2-2264509876)

maya: seeing ~60% 502s for the last 3m. Affected routes: /api/v1/session, /webhook/*, and some static assets. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/s/dash/ingress-euc2 (link)

raj: confirming region euc2? Any AZ affinity?

maya: yes euc2a/b/c. Error rate spikes spike at the ALB level, but envoy upstreams show connection resets.

carlos: grabbing ELB target group health and Envoy stats now.

carlos: aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn tg-abc123 -> 20% unhealthy, increasing. Backend pods show 502s in logs: "upstream reset by peer".

amelia: kubectl get pods -ningress shows 3/5 ingress-nginx pods Ready==0 on one node (euc2b) — CrashLoopBackOff on two due to repeated SIGPIPE in envoy, logs show long GC pauses and 'connection pool exhausted'.

maya: quick customer impact numbers: errors peaked ~12k rps failing, top customers (org-42, org-77) reporting login/webhook failures. This is P1.

sre-lead: ok, immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce incoming weight to euc2 via Route53 weighted failover (shift 70%->backup region) 2) scale ingress pods in euc2 to absorb slow upstreams 3) adjust ALB deregistration delay/connection draining 4) open mitigation channel and notify support

oncall-ops: I'm on routing changes. Preparing Route53 change-batch to shift weights (backup: euc4). Will stage 10% then 50 then 90 if metrics look good.

deploy-bot: @oncall-ops deployment window check passed, no infra deploys ongoing in euc2 in last 30m.

raj: while route shift happens, can we reduce keepalive time and connection pool size on Envoy to avoid head-of-line exhaustion? Amelia, can you push a temporary config?

amelia: yes, pushing a conservative config: max_connections_per_host: 100 -> 50, max_pending_requests: 1024 -> 256. Applying via k8s configmap (ingress-nginx-envoy) now.

amelia: command I ran:
```
kubectl -n ingress set env deployment/ingress-nginx-proxy ENVOY_MAX_CONN=50 ENVOY_MAX_PENDING=256
kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deployment/ingress-nginx-proxy
```
Restarting 5 replicas sequentially.

carlos: also reducing ALB deregistration delay to 30s for faster draining so unhealthy backends get removed quicker. aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --attributes Key=deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds,Value=30

maya: route53 change in progress: staged 15% -> 85% to euc4 over next 6m. Monitoring error rate.

incident-bot: Route53 change submitted: change-id: C123456789 (status PENDING).

carlos: seeing early signal: 502 rate dropping in euc4, but euc2 still has bursts. Node euc2b kernel shows very high ephemeral socket usage, conntrack table at 95%.

raj: conntrack exhaustion — that explains resets. Can netops increase conntrack_max or we rotate nodes?

oncall-ops: req'ing kernel param bump on the node group (conntrack_max -> 262144) and cordon/drain the problematic node in euc2b. Starting now.

maya: cordon/drain command: kubectl cordon ip-10-0-146-22 && kubectl drain ip-10-0-146-22 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data

amelia: node drained, two ingress pods rescheduled to other nodes. Observability: pending requests on remaining ingress instances temporarily rose but then stabilized after the Envoy config change.

carlos: Route53 weight at 85% euc4, 15% euc2. Error rate org-wide fell from 60%->12% over 8m.

sre-lead: good. Next: increase autoscaling for ingress controller in euc2 and patch docker image with a fix for connection pool leak (postmortem dev task). Also track per-org impact for support.

maya: customer impact summary for support (to post in incidents-support):
- window: 2026-03-15T02:31Z -> ongoing
- effected endpoints: /api/v1/session, /webhook/*, static asset CDN edge behind ALB
- peak failed rps: ~12k
- affected customers: org-42 (high), org-77 (moderate), multiple small users
- mitigation: route53 weighted shift to euc4, Envoy connection limits reduced, node drained, conntrack increased

raj: any evidence of deployment causing this? No deploys but investigate recent config push to ingress earlier today (06:00Z). Amelia, please pull the last config diff.

amelia: diff shows a change to upstream keepalive: keepalive_timeout 75s -> 120s pushed at 05:55Z. Rolling that back now to 60s as a mitigation.

deploy-bot: rollback config change detected: ingress-keepalive rollback triggered by amelia (run id: rb-7782).

carlos: health checks improving. ALB target unhealthy dropping to 2% over last 5m.

sre-lead: action items assigned:
- amelia: push final envoy config rollback + prepare patch for leak (ETA 48h)
- carlos: coordinate kernel conntrack bump and verify autoscaling policies (ETA 1h)
- raj: run post-incident network stress test in staging to repro (ETA 24h)
- maya: draft incident summary and customer outreach notes, coordinate with support (ETA 30m)

maya: posting interim update to status page, advising that services are degraded but traffic shift largely successful.

incident-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai: INC-2264509876 - Partial outage: ingress euc2 (most traffic shifted).

oncall-ops: leaving handoff notes for next oncall: conntrack param changed, node drained, route53 weight at 85% to euc4, watch ALB target group health for 30m, pending: update ASG scaling policy for ingress.

sre-lead: thanks team. We'll keep this thread open for the next updates and final RCA. Good job on quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
